provenance: Each picture is the output of this project's own code. The board comes from the generator with the seed below. A board drawing comes from slwindow, and a game picture comes from the 3D window, slwindow3d. No scan and no photograph is in any of them (SR-07).

images.shows: A village board: the woods mass, the building plans, the roads, a hill with its crest line, the grain fields, and the wall and hedge hexsides
A city board: blocks of stone buildings, each with the wall line of one building and the panel lines of its hexes
A hills board: three levels of brown, the crest lines of rule 43.2, and the cliff hexsides of rule 44.1
The 3D window in its 2D camera mode, in turn 3 of scenario 4: the board from above, the counter cards of the two sides with their vehicles, and the panel with the legal commands and the action log
The 3D window in its 3D camera mode, at the same position: the hex prisms, the buildings, and the counter cards seen from the south
